tests.name: Dictionary: forty original answers, eighty extras, unique five-letter words, strict validation and wrap
Duplicate scoring: exact matches first, repeated letters consume only remaining occurrences
Persistent store: invalid guesses, bounded typing, immutable playing-next, wins, loss, streaks and reset
Malformed storage and unavailable storage remain playable; original share contains no emoji
Real independent static source, byte-identical public resources and under-three-megabyte export
Preview server responds at final public subpath and does not expose repository or private source
Desktop first-visit help: native focus containment, blocked game input, keyboard dismissal and self-hosted fonts
Stats keyboard opening, real zero baseline, reset cancellation and return to game
Desktop physical input: short/unknown guesses rejected, max length, delete, real staggered flip and keyboard precedence
Desktop actual win, one-time stats, history, exact clipboard text and restored completed round
Clipboard denial: truthful fallback offers the actual selectable result
Mobile touch and reduced motion: help, real round win, next answer, repeated-letter states, no overflow
Mobile genuine six-guess loss, streak reset, history, reload idempotence and reset confirmation
Responsive 1440px and 320px layouts, meaningful visible content before and after interaction
Browser recovery from corrupt saved JSON and denied localStorage, with real playable fallback
No HTTP, request, external-network, console or page errors across all actual browser interactions

压缩桌面垂直留白，首屏截图置于scrollY=0并断言页脚不超出900px。
